description: Wyoming SNAP uses a paper application submitted to DFS, followed by an interview. The dedicated interview line is different from the local office handling case questions.
introduction: Wyoming SNAP uses a paper application submitted to DFS, followed by an interview. The dedicated interview line is different from the local office handling case questions.

who: Households meeting SNAP financial and program rules as assessed by DFS.
Tell the worker about household composition and any student, work-rule or disability circumstances.
sections.get: Food benefits for approved households. Ask about current permitted purchases and the reporting rules in the decision notice.
sections.docs: Prepare household identity, income and relevant expense records. A signed application with name and address begins the process; return further verification requested by DFS.
sections.apply:
1. Download the English or Spanish application from the DFS SNAP page.
  2. Submit it to the local DFS office in person, by mail, fax or email to snappowerservice@wyo.gov.
  3. After filing, complete the interview at 307-777-8550 or the local office.
  4. The interview line operates Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Friday 9 a.m.–4 p.m.; it is closed Thursday.
sections.after: Contact the local office for status or case questions; the interview number is reserved for interviews. Keep proof of submission and follow verification and renewal deadlines. Explain an urgent food shortage and ask about expedited screening.
sections.sources:
• DFS SNAP application and interview routes
  • SNAP application and expedited policy
  • USA Assistance background and screenshots

faqs: Is there a Wyoming online SNAP benefit portal application?
The current DFS page directs people to a paper application and accepted submission routes.
DFS lists snappowerservice@wyo.gov for applications and verification.
Can I ask the interview line for case status?
No; DFS directs case questions to the local office.
The dedicated interview line is closed Thursday for processing.
Can I ask for expedited review?
DFS policy provides expedited screening; explain the urgent household situation.

provenance.review_scope: Program purpose, eligibility pathway and application methods; no unverified dollar limits published.
